content:
Welcome to OER-Forge, a collection of open-source tools built to solve real problems in education.
Our Mission We create focused, purpose-built tools that educators can use, modify, and share. Each tool does one thing well and works independently, but together they form a cohesive ecosystem for building and sharing quality educational resources.
Current Tools RaiseMyHand – Real-time classroom question management. Anonymous student questions ranked by peer upvotes help instructors focus on what matters most.
WikiAccess – Convert DokuWiki pages to accessible, WCAG 2.1 compliant documents in multiple formats.
Get Involved Check out our GitHub organization Report issues or contribute to any of our tools Help us build the next tool in the suite Built by educators, for educators.

content:
OER-Forge is a collection of tools created to solve real problems in teaching and learning.
Tools WikiAccess – Convert DokuWiki pages to accessible, WCAG 2.1 compliant documents. Exports to HTML, Word (.docx), and Markdown. Handles images, LaTeX equations, and generates accessibility reports. Useful for converting course materials into multiple formats while ensuring they’re accessible to everyone. [Repository]
RaiseMyHand – Real-time classroom question management. Students submit questions anonymously and upvote each other’s questions—like Reddit, but for your classroom. Instructors get a dashboard to see, moderate, and respond to the most important questions. Built with FastAPI, WebSockets, and works with Docker. Designed for lectures, labs, seminars, and online courses. [Repository]
jupyter2hugo – A command-line tool to convert Jupyter Notebooks into Hugo-compatible Markdown files. Preserves code cells, outputs, and metadata for seamless integration into Hugo static sites. Ideal for educators and content creators who want to share Jupyter Notebook content on their Hugo-powered websites. [Repository]
License MIT License
